name: launch-dashboard
description: A live release-day mission control on simulated launch data: a ticking clock, 4 KPI tiles with rolling numbers and sparklines (tap one to focus it), a streaming area chart with hover values, rollout/apdex/CPU gauges and an event ticker; tiles wrap 2×2 on phones. Submits nothing.

release.description: Release name or tag shown under the title (default "v2.4.0")
